integrity: The proof independently derives total domination from vector-space covers, proves the equality case for a cover by q+1 proper subspaces, counts all minimum total sets, and derives paired domination by parity plus an explicit perfect matching.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes dimension at least three; dimension two gives an edgeless graph.
For even residue-field order, the paired-domination number is determined but all minimum paired sets are not classified.
The finite verifier covers representative prime fields only; arbitrary prime powers are handled symbolically.
Equivalent finite-geometry cover terminology creates a residual originality risk.
title: Minimum total-domination pencils in finite subspace-intersection graphs
